mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COALESCE( SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0 ) AS successCount, COALESCE( SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'NO_RESULT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0 ) AS noResultCount, COALESCE( SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0 ) AS failedCount, CAST( COALESCE(AVG(duration_ms), 0) AS UNSIGNED ) AS avgDurationMs FROM knowledge_query_log WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
